working_definition: Tm5c is a wide-field glutamatergic transmedullary columnar neuron of the adult Drosophila optic lobe. It spans approximately eight medulla columns with dendritic branches in layers M1, M3, and M6, preferentially receives input from R8 photoreceptors of yellow ommatidia (in M3) and from Dm8 amacrine neurons (in M6), and projects its axon to the lobula near the layer 5/6 boundary where it outputs to Li4. It is one of three established Tm5 subtypes (Tm5a/b/c) distinguished by chromatic R7/R8 input preference.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary Tm5 neuron that spans around eight medulla columns with lateral branches expanding out into the M1, M3 and M6 layers from a single vertical dendrite (Kind et al., 2021). It preferentially receives input from R8 (rather than R7) photoreceptor cells, and in most, but not all, cases these cells are selective for yellow (rather than pale) ommatidia (Kind et al., 2021). Its R8 input is mainly in layer M3 and it also receives input from the distal medullary amacrine neuron Dm8 in layer M6 (Karuppudurai et al., 2014). Its axon terminates near the boundary between lobula layers 5 and 6, with some cells having a branch in layer 4 (Kind et al., 2021). It provides input to the lobula intrinsic neuron Li4 via many synapses (Lin et al., 2016). It is a glutamatergic neuron (Gao et al., 2008; Karuppudurai et al., 2014).

justification: The cluster label 'Tm5c' is the established anatomical name for this adult optic lobe neuron subtype. FBbt:00110074 'transmedullary neuron Tm5c' is a non-obsolete term whose definition matches the cluster on every diagnostic feature: wide-field transmedullary columnar neuron, ~8-column span, dendritic branches in medulla M1/M3/M6, preferential R8 input with yellow-ommatidium bias, Dm8 input in M6, axon terminating at lobula layers 5/6 boundary, glutamatergic neurotransmitter. The Kurmangaliyev 2020 atlas profiles adult fly optic lobe neurons; this is the adult form. The label and biology are identical; no disambiguating qualifier is needed.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Parent class encompassing all Tm5 subtypes (Tm5a, Tm5b, Tm5c).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Too broad: this is the parent of Tm5a/b/c. The cluster is specifically Tm5c and FBbt:00110074 matches at the correct level of specificity.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Immature form of the transmedullary neuron Tm5c (Konstantinides et al., 2022). It is a Notch OFF hemilineage secondary neuron, born from a medulla forming neuroblast during the Opa/Erm temporal window (Konstantinides et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Wrong developmental stage: this term covers the immature/developing form. Kurmangaliyev 2020 is an adult optic lobe atlas; the cluster represents mature adult neurons.

recommendation: Map cluster Tm5c to FBbt:00110074 (transmedullary neuron Tm5c) with skos:exactMatch. The term is current, non-obsolete, and its definition precisely matches the adult glutamatergic, R8-preferring, yellow-ommatidium-biased Tm5c subtype profiled in this atlas.
